description: Returns a prompt template built from one ad, written for the user to run on their own product. The result is JSON with the template text in the template field. kind='swipe' is a template that maps the ad's beats, checks the fit with the user's product, drafts a full version with the same structure and adds alternative hooks. kind='analysis' is a template that breaks down why the ad works (audience, funnel, psychology, weak spots) and how its structure applies to a business. product and niche are written into the template; without product the template keeps a placeholder for it.

annotate.description: Mark the copy blocks inside the script when available (swipe only)

key.description: adKey ("meta:<id>"), a bare id or a Meta Ad Library id

kind.description: swipe = rebuild the ad for another product; analysis = why the ad works

niche.description: Angle or audience for the template (swipe only)

product.description: The user's product, written into the template

name: get_swipe_prompt
title: Swipe prompt
